workload: Fold a 58KB DESCRIPTION line (meeting minutes) 25 times, the line encode() and ContactRecord.vcard() fold.
notes: Each character is encoded to UTF-8 just to learn its octet width, after the whole line was already encoded for the 75-octet check. Folding the encoded buffer once keeps the same RFC 5545 line breaks and was about an order of magnitude faster on a line this size in a local probe.

workload: Resolve the same 15 camelCase list-column names across 5000 rows, as get_property does for undeclared site columns.
notes: Every call runs re.sub, and a page repeats a handful of names. Caching the pure function, as internal_field_name already does, was about 20x on this page in a local probe and does not change the spelling.

workload: One streamed JSON array page of 2500 records by 22 short columns, a wide list or user export.
notes: json.dump uses the default ', ' and ': ' separators, so about 16.5% of this page is spaces. separators=(',', ':') keeps json.loads identical, which is what the native test checks. record_to_json (open PR 1073) is a different function and was not used.
